SCRIPT.KOREAN: 저 이런 거 처음 먹어 봐요!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’ve never had something like this before!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我还是第一次吃这种东西！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我還是第一次吃這種東西！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私、こういうの食べるの初めてです！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku belum pernah makan yang kayak gini sebelumnya!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu nunca comi algo assim antes!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Es la primera vez que pruebo esto!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: وای من تا حالا یه همچین چیزی نخورده بودم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Really? It’s spicy—are you sure you’re okay with that?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 是嗎？這很辣欸，你真的沒問題？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: そうですか？辛いですけど大丈夫ですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Gitu ya? Ini pedes, kamu yakin nggak apa-apa?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: É picante, será que você aguenta?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: جدی میگی؟ خیلی تنده ها، مطمئنی اکی هستی؟

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: これってそんなに辛いんですか？

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 네 지금이라도 우유 사오시는 게 좋을 것 같은데
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yeah, might be smart to grab some milk while you can.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 有啊，我觉得你现在去买瓶牛奶会比较好哦
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 嗯，現在去買個牛奶可能比較好喔
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい、今からでも牛乳を買ってきたほうがよさそうだけど
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Iya, mending sekarang juga beli susu deh, kalau nggak kuat.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu como bem comida apimentada, então está tudo bem.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Tal vez sería mejor que vayas a comprar leche.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: خیلی! هنوز دیر نشده، تا نسوختی برو یه شیر بخر بیار.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 괜찮아요. 저 매운 거 잘 먹어요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’ll be fine. I can handle spicy food.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 没关系啦，我挺能吃辣的
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 大丈夫です。私、辛いの得意ですから。
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nggak apa-apa kok. Aku tahan pedes, serius.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Soporto bien el picante, no te preocupes.

SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Aquele panfleto que estava em cima da mesa antes?

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아까 그 테이블에 있던 전단지.. 그거 뭐예요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: That flyer on the table earlier… what was that?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 刚才桌子上那张传单...那是什么啊？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 剛才桌上的那張傳單…那是什麼啊？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: さっきテーブルにあったチラシ…あれ何ですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Selebaran yang di meja tadi itu… itu apa, ya?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ese folleto en la mesa... ¿qué era?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اون تراکتی که روی میز بود... داستانش چیه؟

SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não é bico, eu administro uma pensão.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: It’s for the boarding house I run.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 是我经营的合租公寓的传单
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那是我經營的合宿公寓傳單啦
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺が経営している下宿のチラシです
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Itu brosur rumah kos yang aku kelola.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: تبلیغ همون پانسیونیه که خودم مدیریتش رو به عهده دارم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I actually got into the accident while handing those out.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 结果出去发传单的时候出了车祸...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 說是去發那個的時候出了車禍
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: それを配っているとき事故にあったみたいで
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku kecelakaan pas lagi bagi-bagi itu, katanya.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ele sofreu o acidente enquanto distribuía aquilo.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Me dijeron que tuve el accidente mientras los repartía.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: راستش سر پخش کردن همونا تصادف کردم و رفتم توی کما.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아 근데 눈 뜨자마자 이런 거 먹어도 돼요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: By the way, is it okay to be eating something like this right after waking up?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 但是刚醒过来就能吃这种东西吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 可是剛醒來就吃這種東西沒問題嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ところで、目を覚ましたばかりなのにこんなの食べて大丈夫なんですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi yakin nih baru melek langsung makan yang kayak gini?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mas pode comer isso logo depois de acordar?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Está bien comer algo así apenas despiertas?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: راستی تو تازه چشمتو وا کردی، اصلاً درسته غذای تند بخوری؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What, you think it’ll kill me?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 难道还能吃出人命不成？？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: まさかこれで死ぬとかはないですよね？？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Emangnya aku bakal mati gara-gara ini?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não vou morrer por causa disso, né??
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Esto no me va a matar~
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: مگه قراره بمیرم با یه کاسه غذا؟!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 이야~ 이게 얼마 만의 매운 거냐..
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Man, it’s been forever since I’ve had something this spicy…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哇~我都多久没吃辣的了…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いや〜辛いものなんて久しぶりだな…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Wah~ udah lama banget nggak makan yang pedes gini…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Nossa~ fazia quanto tempo que eu não comia um buldak...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: به‌به... نمیدونی چقدر دلم لک زده بود واسه یه غذای تند و آتیشی!

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: さあ、早く食べましょう！
